div.div: MIT/Apache-style licensing on PyPSA + permissive licensing on Vizualizer enables reuse by ministries, regulators and defence stakeholders alike. Public ECMWF/Zenodo provenance avoids licensing collisions. Open-source carve-out under EU Reg. 2021/821 simplifies cross-border collaboration.

div.div: Three-tab UI (Builder · Runs · Results) maps directly to RACI roles: analyst configures, operator monitors, decision-maker reviews. Sequential queue documents runs; persistent state (planui-state.json) provides organisational audit trail across restarts and shift changes.

div.div: SI units enforced (MWh, MW, EUR/MWh). Country / asset codes follow ISO-3166-1 (RO, BG, HU, RS) and ENTSO-E component identifiers. Result schema names align with TYNDP output expectations: system_cost, generation_mix, lmp_summary, ens_summary, curtailment, daily_net_imports, interconnector_flow_congestion. Bilingual UI labels (EN/RO) preserve a single semantic layer.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 548px; height: 1px; padding-top: 498px; margin-left: 620px;

div.div:
• YAML configuration (industry-standard, schema-versioned)
• netCDF cutouts (CF conventions for climate data)
• CSV result contract – 7 mandatory files with stable column names
• REST API (HTTP/JSON) for queue, scenario and result endpoints
• drawio (mxGraph) + SVG for figure portability across editors
• Snakemake DAG for reproducible cross-host execution
• Conda env spec for deterministic dependency resolution

(underpinning)

div.div: Coordination, monitoring, accountability — the cross-cutting governance underpinning all four EIF layers.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 548px; height: 1px; padding-top: 608px; margin-left: 620px;

div.div: Job state JSON, immutable templates and per-run logs constitute a governance audit envelope. Snakemake provenance is reproducible from form input to delivered figure. Each result inherits assumptions_limitations.md so policy briefings carry their epistemic provenance forward.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 1138px; height: 1px; padding-top: 669px; margin-left: 29px;

div.div: Each layer is enforced by an explicit artefact in the codebase – making interoperability a verifiable property rather than aspirational claim.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 1138px; height: 1px; padding-top: 693px; margin-left: 29px;

div.div: The four-layer European Interoperability Framework (EIF) is augmented with a fifth governance layer aligned with the ESPD–PSD/CIRA modernisation agenda.
